products.title: Midnight Marble
products.description: Midnight Marble takes the look of polished stone: veins that split and rejoin, a little depth under the surface, and a quiet base colour that does not shout. The veining is drawn for this cover rather than scanned from a slab, so it stays crisp at the corners where photographs of stone go soft.

metadata.detail_material: Soft silicone: flexible TPU, 1.5 mm across the back, matte-touch. Glass back: 0.6 mm tempered glass bonded to a TPU bumper, printed on the underside so the art sits behind the glass and cannot wear.
metadata.detail_print: Full-bleed veined pattern carried over the sides, so the stone does not stop at the edge. Matte on silicone; under glass the veins pick up a soft depth.
metadata.detail_fit: Cut for each of the 12 listed models: the camera opening follows that phone's island and the buttons and ports stay open. A 1.2 mm lip runs around the screen and the camera so the phone rests on the case, not on glass.
metadata.detail_care: Wipe with a damp cloth and a drop of mild soap; a dry microfibre cloth keeps the glass streak-free. Keep it out of direct sun for long stretches. Do not use alcohol or acetone on the print.

products.title: Aurora Night
products.description: Aurora Night is a near-black sky with ribbons of colour folded through it, soft at the edges and brighter where they cross. The composition is weighted toward the lower half so the camera island sits in the dark.

metadata.detail_material: Soft silicone: flexible TPU, 1.5 mm across the back, matte-touch. Glass back: 0.6 mm tempered glass bonded to a TPU bumper, printed on the underside so the art sits behind the glass and cannot wear.
metadata.detail_print: Smooth gradients with no visible banding. The darkest areas print as true black rather than dark grey, which keeps the ribbons looking lit from behind.
metadata.detail_fit: Cut for each of the 9 listed models: the camera opening follows that phone's island and the buttons and ports stay open. A 1.2 mm lip runs around the screen and the camera so the phone rests on the case, not on glass.
metadata.detail_care: Wipe with a damp cloth and a drop of mild soap; a dry microfibre cloth keeps the glass streak-free. Keep it out of direct sun for long stretches. Do not use alcohol or acetone on the print.

products.title: Checker Wave
products.description: Checker Wave is sharp geometry in candy colours: a grid that warps as it crosses the back, with a second colour showing through the gaps. It reads loud from across the room and clean up close.

metadata.detail_material: Flexible TPU, 1.5 mm across the back and thicker at the corners, with a matte-touch finish that does not hold fingerprints. It bends to go on and off and settles back flat.
metadata.detail_print: Hard-edged shapes with high contrast. Edges are vector-sharp, a full row meets the top edge, and the warp is centred on the back rather than drifting toward a corner.
metadata.detail_fit: Cut for each of the 11 listed models: the camera opening follows that phone's island and the buttons and ports stay open. A 1.2 mm lip runs around the screen and the camera so the phone rests on the case, not on glass.
metadata.detail_care: Wipe with a damp cloth and a drop of mild soap. Keep it out of direct sun for long stretches, since TPU yellows slowly under UV. Do not use alcohol or acetone on the print.

products.title: Edge-to-edge tempered glass
products.description: A 0.33 mm tempered glass guard that covers the whole display up to the curve, with an oleophobic coat so fingerprints wipe off. It is cut for your exact model, so the earpiece and front camera stay open.

metadata.detail_material: Tempered glass, 9H surface hardness, oleophobic coating, 2.5D rounded edges.
metadata.detail_in_box: Screen guard, alcohol wipe, dry cloth, dust stickers and an alignment frame.
metadata.detail_fit: Cut for each listed model. Leaves room at the edges so it works with every cover we sell.
metadata.detail_care: Clean with a dry microfibre cloth. Replace it if it cracks; it has done its job.

products.title: Privacy tempered glass
products.description: The same 9H glass with a privacy layer: straight on, the screen looks normal; from about 30° to either side, it turns dark. Useful on the metro, in queues and in office lifts.

metadata.detail_material: Tempered glass with a micro-louvre privacy layer, 9H hardness, oleophobic coating.
metadata.detail_in_box: Privacy guard, alcohol wipe, dry cloth, dust stickers and an alignment frame.
metadata.detail_fit: Cut for each listed model, with cut-outs for the earpiece and front camera.
metadata.detail_care: Clean with a dry microfibre cloth. Screen brightness may need one step up.

products.title: Camera lens protector
products.description: Individual glass rings that sit over each camera lens and keep the camera bump off the table. The glass is optically clear and coated against flare, so photos and night shots are unchanged.

metadata.detail_material: Optical glass lenses in aluminium rings, anti-reflective coating.
metadata.detail_in_box: Lens protector set, alignment tray, alcohol wipe and dry cloth.
metadata.detail_fit: Shaped to each listed model’s camera island.
metadata.detail_care: Wipe with a dry cloth before taking photos for the clearest shots.

products.title: Full-frame matte back film
products.description: A thin matte film that wraps the whole back and the side frame, with a cut-out for the camera. It keeps scratches off and adds grip for people who like their phone without a cover.

metadata.detail_material: 0.2 mm TPU film with a matte finish and a self-healing top layer.
metadata.detail_in_box: Back film, squeegee card, alcohol wipe and dry cloth.
metadata.detail_fit: Cut for each listed model, including the camera island and buttons.
metadata.detail_care: Small scratches fade on their own. It peels off cleanly with no residue.

products.title: Full-frame carbon back film
products.description: A textured carbon-look film for the full back and sides. It changes the look of a bare phone and adds grip, and you can still wear a clear cover over it.

metadata.detail_material: 0.25 mm textured vinyl film with an air-release adhesive.
metadata.detail_in_box: Back film, squeegee card, alcohol wipe and dry cloth.
metadata.detail_fit: Cut for each listed model, including the camera island and buttons.
metadata.detail_care: Wipe with a damp cloth. It peels off cleanly with no residue.

products.title: Body protection film
products.description: A clear, self-healing film that wraps the whole body of the phone: back, side frame and the area around the camera, cut by machine for each flagship. It is thicker than our back films, nearly invisible, and keeps the phone looking new under or without a cover.

metadata.detail_material: 0.2 mm thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) with a self-healing top coat and UV-stable adhesive, so it does not yellow.
metadata.detail_in_box: Back panel film, two side-frame strips, camera surround piece, squeegee card, alcohol wipe and dry cloth.
metadata.detail_fit: Cut for each listed flagship, including the buttons, ports and camera island. Fits under our covers.
metadata.detail_care: Fine scratches fade in warm weather. It peels off cleanly with no residue.

products.title: Wireless earbuds ANC
products.description: In-ear wireless earbuds with active noise cancellation for the metro and the office, and a transparency mode for when you need to hear the announcement. Four mics keep calls clear, and the case charges over USB-C.

metadata.detail_in_box: Earbuds, charging case, USB-C cable, three sizes of ear tips.

products.title: Wireless earbuds Lite
products.description: Light everyday earbuds with a game mode that cuts audio delay for videos and mobile games. Tap controls on each bud, and they reconnect to your phone as soon as you open the case.

metadata.detail_in_box: Earbuds, charging case, USB-C cable, spare ear tips.

products.title: Neckband Pro
products.description: A flexible neckband that sits comfortably all day, with call noise reduction for busy streets and magnetic earbuds that clip together when you are not listening. Ten minutes on the charger gives a full day of commuting.

metadata.detail_in_box: Neckband, USB-C cable, spare ear tips.

products.title: Neckband
products.description: A light, simple neckband for music and calls, with buttons you can find without looking and a flexible band that packs into a pocket.

metadata.detail_in_box: Neckband, USB-C cable.

products.title: Pocket speaker
products.description: A small, waterproof speaker with a strap for bags and bikes. Loud enough for a room, and two of them pair together for stereo.

metadata.detail_in_box: Speaker, strap, USB-C cable.

products.title: Party speaker
products.description: A 20 W speaker with a passive bass radiator for fuller sound and a light ring that follows the beat. Fifteen hours of playback covers a long evening, and it charges your phone in a pinch.

metadata.detail_in_box: Speaker, USB-C cable, AUX cable.

products.title: 20 W USB-C fast charger
products.description: A compact 20 W USB-C wall charger with Power Delivery, the fast-charging standard iPhone, Pixel and Nothing phones use. It charges any USB-C phone, and cuts power if it gets too hot or sees a surge.

metadata.detail_in_box: Charger. Cable sold separately.

products.title: 33 W dual-port charger
products.description: One plug, two ports: USB-C for your phone and USB-A for earbuds, a watch or an older cable. It shares 33 W between them and works with almost any phone.

metadata.detail_in_box: Charger. Cable sold separately.

products.title: 45 W PPS fast charger
products.description: A 45 W USB-C charger with PPS, the variable-voltage fast charging that Samsung Galaxy phones need for their top speed. It also speaks Power Delivery, so it fast-charges iPhone, Pixel and Nothing phones and powers a tablet.

metadata.detail_in_box: Charger. Cable sold separately; use a 5 A USB-C cable for 45 W.

products.title: 65 W GaN charger, 3 ports
products.description: Gallium nitride (GaN) parts keep this 65 W charger about the size of a phone charger. Two USB-C ports and one USB-A share the power, enough for a laptop and a phone at the same time.

metadata.detail_in_box: Charger. Cable sold separately.

products.title: Car charger 38 W
products.description: A small metal car charger that sits almost flush in the 12/24 V socket. USB-C fast-charges your phone on the way while USB-A looks after a passenger’s phone.

metadata.detail_in_box: Car charger. Cable sold separately.

products.title: Original Apple USB-C to USB-C cable
products.description: Apple’s own woven USB-C charge cable, sealed in its retail box. It fast-charges iPhone 15 and newer with a 20 W or higher USB-C charger, and syncs with a Mac or PC.

metadata.detail_in_box: Apple USB-C charge cable (1 m), in Apple’s sealed box.

products.title: Original Apple USB-C to Lightning cable
products.description: Apple’s own USB-C to Lightning cable, sealed in its retail box. With a 20 W USB-C charger it fast-charges iPhone 8 to iPhone 14 to 50% in about 30 minutes.

metadata.detail_in_box: Apple USB-C to Lightning cable (1 m), in Apple’s sealed box.

products.title: Original Samsung USB-C cable 3 A
products.description: Samsung’s own USB-C to USB-C cable, sealed. Rated for 3 A, it carries 25 W fast charging to Galaxy phones from a PPS charger.

metadata.detail_in_box: Samsung USB-C cable (1 m), sealed.

products.title: Original OnePlus SUPERVOOC cable
products.description: OnePlus’s own SUPERVOOC cable, sealed. SUPERVOOC needs the brand’s cable and charger together; with them, a OnePlus phone charges at its full rated speed. It also charges any USB-C phone normally.

metadata.detail_in_box: OnePlus SUPERVOOC cable (1 m), sealed.

products.title: Braided USB-C to USB-C cable 60 W
products.description: Our everyday USB-C cable with a nylon braid and strain relief at both ends, so it survives bags and bedside tables. 60 W covers fast charging on every USB-C phone and most laptops.

metadata.detail_in_box: Braided USB-C cable with a strap.

products.title: Braided USB-C to Lightning cable
products.description: A braided USB-C to Lightning cable for iPhone 14 and older. With a 20 W USB-C charger it fast-charges as quickly as the cable in Apple’s box.

metadata.detail_in_box: Braided USB-C to Lightning cable with a strap.
